## Flormar: 2x More Clicks with AI-Powered Send-Time Optimization

Flormar, one of the world's leading cosmetics brands, produces and sells makeup products across both physical stores and digital channels. To stay competitive in a market where every click counts, Flormar needed to stop guessing and start predicting.

With D·engage's AI-powered Send-Time Optimization, Flormar now reaches each customer at exactly the moment they are most likely to engage. Paired with data-driven Predictive Segmentation, every message lands with the right content at the right time. The result: SMS click rates doubled.

2x

increase in SMS click-through rates

30%

increase in email and push click-through rates

50%

improvement in campaign operational efficiency

### The Problem: Reaching the Right Customer at the Right Time

Before D·engage, Flormar’s CRM team was dealing with three frustrating bottlenecks:

**Data was stuck in silos.** Customer data lived in multiple places and couldn’t be easily transferred or combined into one view. The team couldn’t see the full picture of who their customers were or what they wanted.

**Segmentation was slow and limited.** Building audience segments required heavy manual effort and constant back-and-forth with the technical team. By the time a segment was ready, the moment had often passed.

**Campaign reporting was a black box.** SMS and email sends went out, but measuring what actually worked and why was difficult. Without clear performance data, improving campaigns was mostly guesswork.

What Flormar needed was a platform that could unify their customer data, predict what each person wanted to buy next, and deliver the right message at exactly the right time.

They needed D·engage.

![flormar hero section](https://dengage.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/flormar_hero_section.png)

![block2](https://dengage.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Block2.png)

### What Flormar Was Looking For

Flormar’s team had a clear vision for what “better” looked like:

- A single place to analyze customer data shopping history, campaign interactions, behavioral signals all in one platform
- The ability to build meaningful segments quickly, without needing developers for every step
- SMS and email sends tailored to what each customer actually cares about
- Detailed reporting so the team could continuously improve, not just report upward

Most importantly, they wanted to move from broadcast marketing to genuine one-to-one communication where each message feels like it was written for that person specifically.

## How D·engage Made It Happen

Getting Up and Running, Faster Than Expected

Onboarding was structured: scheduled orientation sessions, dedicated training, and a clear go-live plan. The real learning happened quickly once the team started using the platform day-to-day and whenever questions came up, D·engage's support team were there to help them move forward without getting stuck.

![flormar cs sms notifications](https://dengage.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Flormar_cs_sms_notifications.png)

### Predictive Segmentation: Knowing What Customers Want Before They Do

This is where the real transformation happened. Using D·engage’s Predictive Segmentation, Flormar analyzed customers’ online behavior and past purchase data to understand which product categories each customer was most likely to buy next.

Instead of sending the same campaign to the entire audience, Flormar rebuilt its campaigns around these predictions. This made it possible to deliver messages that were more relevant to each customer’s interests.

The result was clear:

- more relevant campaigns
- higher engagement
- a more data-driven approach to campaign planning

### AI Send-Time Optimization: Reaching Customers at Exactly the Right Moment

This is where the impact on click rate became most visible. D·engage’s AI-powered Send-Time Optimization analyzes each customer’s engagement habits and automatically delivers messages at the time they are most likely to open and click.

When combined with Predictive Segmentation, Flormar was able to match the right content with the right timing for each customer. This made campaigns more effective while also reducing the manual effort required to set them up.

As a result, Flormar achieved:

- 2x more clicks
- 50% improvement in campaign operational efficiency

This allowed the CRM team to launch smarter campaigns in less time.

![automation](https://dengage.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Automation.png)

“ Since we started working with D·engage, the real shift for us wasn’t just operational efficiency, it was moving from intuition to prediction. By combining predictive segmentation with AI-driven send-time optimization, we started delivering the right message at the right moment, and that’s what drove a clear uplift in engagement and performance. ”

### One Platform for Email, SMS, and Beyond

Email marketing and SMS campaigns are now managed from a single panel. Building audiences, scheduling sends, running A/B tests, and reading performance reports all happen in one place, cutting down on operational back-and-forth and giving the team a consistent view of what’s working.

## What Flormar's Team Says

"The most important thing for us is that it's user-friendly. We track D·engage's new developments closely and test demos regularly. When a feature makes a real difference like predictive segments and time optimization we roll it out to live campaigns."

Flormar CRM Team

![](https://dengage.com/customer-stories/flormar-2x-more-clicks-with-ai-powered-send-time-optimization/)

![flormar x dengage logos](https://dengage.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Flormar_X_Dengage_Logos.png)

### The Results

Three metrics tell the story clearly:

- **SMS click-through rates** approximately **doubled**, driven primarily by AI Send-Time Optimization ensuring messages arrived when customers were most ready to engage.
- Email and push **click-through rates increased by around 30%**.
- Campaign operational efficiency saw an **average 50% improvement**, thanks to faster segmentation, less manual coordination, and smarter automation.

Beyond these results, the team also saw meaningful improvements in open rates and conversion rates across channels demonstrating that customers were not just clicking more, but engaging more deeply with the content.
